title: CNBC: Facebook enlists Luxottica to co-develop AR glasses (Orion)
detail: CNBC reported Facebook had enlisted Ray-Ban maker Luxottica to co-develop AR glasses codenamed Orion; EssilorLuxottica later said the two have worked on wearables "since 2019".

title: Facebook–Luxottica smart-glasses partnership announced at Connect 2020
detail: The smart-glasses partnership was publicly announced around Facebook Connect 2020 (Wikipedia gives 2020-09-20; the keynote was 2020-09-16).

title: Quest 2 unveiled at Facebook Connect (US$299 / US$399)
detail: Quest 2 announced at Facebook Connect 2020 at US$299 (64GB) / US$399 (256GB).

title: Quest 2 ships; 4 IR tracking cameras, no colour passthrough
detail: Quest 2 went on sale with four infrared tracking cameras and no colour passthrough.

title: Ray-Ban Stories launched and on sale same day from US$299, dual 5MP cameras
detail: Meta/EssilorLuxottica launched Ray-Ban Stories with "dual integrated 5MP cameras" and 30 s video, from US$299 (€329), in US/AU/CA/IE/IT/UK; announcement and availability on the same day.

title: Connect 2021: company renamed Meta; no new hardware shipped
detail: Facebook rebranded as Meta at Connect 2021; no new hardware was shipped from the event.

title: TechInsights teardown: Ray-Ban Stories cameras fixed-focus, no voice coil or magnets
detail: TechInsights: "The six lenses sit in a fixed focus lens barrel, with no voice coil or magnets." Establishes that Meta's first camera glasses had no autofocus actuator.

title: Connect 2022: Quest Pro announced at US$1,499.99, ships 2022-10-25
detail: Meta announced Quest Pro, its "first full-color mixed reality device" with outward cameras having "4X as many pixels as Quest 2"; pre-orders opened same day.

title: Quest Pro ships (discontinued Sept 2024)
detail: Quest Pro reached retail 14 days after announcement; it was discontinued in September 2024.

title: Meta Reality Labs 'Butterscotch Varifocal' display prototype (mechanical, eye-tracked)
detail: Display-side varifocal prototype using mechanical display movement with eye tracking; seen in search summary only. Not a camera AF element.

title: The Verge leaks Meta's 4-year roadmap: display glasses + neural band 2025, AR 2027
detail: Internal roadmap presented by Mark Rabkin/Alex Himel: Quest 3 ("Stinson") 2023, cheaper "Ventura" 2024, "La Jolla" later; 2nd-gen Ray-Ban glasses fall 2023; 3rd-gen smart glasses with display + neural band 2025; Orion internal testing 2024, consumer launch 202

title: Quest 3 teased by Zuckerberg at US$499, "coming this fall"
detail: Zuckerberg teased Quest 3 at US$499 for fall 2023 and cut the Quest 2 price.

title: Connect 2023: Quest 3 full reveal (2×4MP RGB passthrough, XR2 Gen 2, ships 2023-10-10)
detail: Quest 3 revealed with 2×4MP RGB passthrough cameras, 4 IR cameras, IR depth projector, Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2, 515 g; shipping 2023-10-10.

title: Connect 2023: Ray-Ban Meta announced from US$299, 12MP ultra-wide camera, AR1 Gen1
detail: Ray-Ban Meta announced from US$299 with a "12 MP ultra-wide camera", 1080p video and Snapdragon AR1 Gen1; retail 2023-10-17 in 15 countries.

title: Quest 3 ships (US$499.99 128GB / US$649.99 512GB)
detail: Quest 3 went on sale 13 days after its full reveal.

title: Ray-Ban Meta ships, 20 days after announcement
detail: Ray-Ban Meta (12MP, fixed-focus) reached retail in 15 countries.

title: The Information: Meta working on ~110 g "Puffin" MR glasses with puck, target 2027
detail: The Information reported Meta was developing "Puffin", a ~110 g glasses-like MR device with an external processing puck/battery, no controllers and pancake lenses, targeting 2027.

title: EssilorLuxottica and Meta sign long-term agreement "into the next decade"
detail: EssilorLuxottica: the companies "extended its partnership … new long term agreement, under which the parties will collaborate into the next decade to develop multi-generational smart eyewear products."

title: Connect 2024: Orion true-AR prototype shown; commercial AR glasses "expected 2027"
detail: Orion prototype (≈70° FOV silicon-carbide waveguides, micro-LED, ~98 g, wireless compute puck, EMG wristband) shown to "Meta employees and select external audiences" only; Reuters source: "first commercial AR glasses expected to ship in 2027".

title: Connect 2024: Quest 3S announced (US$299.99/399.99, 2×4MP RGB passthrough, ships 2024-10-15)
detail: Quest 3S announced at US$299.99/399.99 with 2×4MP RGB passthrough cameras, 514 g, shipping 2024-10-15.

title: Meta (Nick Clegg) confirms Quest 3S manufactured in Vietnam
detail: Clegg confirmed Quest 3S would be manufactured in Vietnam, creating "well over a thousand new jobs".

title: Quest 3S ships; Quest 2 and Quest Pro discontinued
detail: Quest 3S reached retail 20 days after announcement; Quest 2 and Quest Pro were discontinued in September 2024.

title: Meta Ray-Ban Display shipped ~84k in 2025; orders raised 80k->150k, 500k two-year goal
detail: Omdia: ~84k shipped after late-year launch (supply constrained). TrendForce: component orders initially ~80k, raised toward 150k, with a 500k two-year shipment goal.

title: Bloomberg roadmap: Oakley "Supernova 2" + "Hypernova" 2025, Orion devs 2026, "Artemis" AR 2027
detail: Gurman: 2025 Oakley glasses "Supernova 2" (centre camera) and "Hypernova" display glasses (~US$1,000, lower-right display, optional "Ceres" wristband); 2026 Orion to developers; 2027 "Artemis" consumer AR glasses lighter than Orion.

title: EssilorLuxottica: 2m Ray-Ban Meta sold; capacity to reach 10m units/yr by end-2026
detail: CEO Milleri said 2m Ray-Ban Meta had been sold since launch and capacity was "set to reach 10 million annual units by the end of next year" (end-2026).

title: Bloomberg: Hypernova to cost US$1,000–1,400, end-2025; binocular "Hypernova 2" for 2027
detail: Gurman reported Hypernova would cost "at least $1,000" up to $1,400, targeted end-2025, plus "Hypernova 2 for 2027 featuring binocular displays" and a Supernova 2 Oakley successor.

title: The Information: next-gen Ray-Ban Meta "Aperol"/"Bellini" for 2026 with super-sensing AI
detail: Next-gen mainstream Ray-Ban Meta codenamed "Aperol" and "Bellini" for 2026, with hours-long "super-sensing" Live AI; facial recognition explored.

title: Anduril and Meta team up on 'EagleEye' military XR to compete for Army SBMC
detail: Anduril press release: 'Anduril and Meta Team Up to Transform XR for the American Military' (EagleEye); to compete for the Army's next-gen HUD (SBMC).

title: UploadVR: Meta prioritises ultralight "Puffin" for end-2026; Quest 4 "Pismo" cancelled
detail: Meta prioritising ultralight "Puffin" (<110 g, tethered puck, gaze-and-pinch) for end-2026; Quest 4 candidates "Pismo Low"/"Pismo High" cancelled; traditional Quest 4 not before 2027.

title: Meta 'Inside Aria Gen 2' blog: fixed-focus research glasses, no AF mentioned
detail: Four global-shutter CV cameras (120 dB HDR, 80° stereo overlap), eye-tracking cameras, 74-76 g; no autofocus, tunable lens or actuator mentioned.

title: WSJ: "Loma" glasses-like headset with pocket compute unit, <US$1,000, 2026 launch
detail: WSJ reported a headset codenamed "Loma", glasses-like with a pocket compute unit, more powerful than Quest 3, "less than $1,000", 2026 launch; Meta courting Disney/A24 for content.

title: Oakley Meta HSTN announced: LE pre-order July 11 at US$499, collection from US$399
detail: "Limited-Edition Oakley Meta HSTN will be available for preorder starting July 11 for $499 USD, with the rest of the collection starting at $399 USD dropping later this summer"; 15 countries, Mexico/India/UAE later.

title: The Information: ultralight headset's primary codename is "Phoenix" (hardware "Loma")
detail: The Information identified the ultralight headset's primary codename as "Phoenix", with hardware candidate "Loma" and platform "Stanley".

title: Meta buys just under 3% of EssilorLuxottica (≈€3bn), considering 5%
detail: Meta acquired just under 3% of EssilorLuxottica (≈€3bn / US$3.5bn) and was "considering" going to 5%; EssilorLuxottica reiterated 10m units/yr capacity by end-2026.

title: Oakley Meta HSTN Limited Edition pre-orders open at US$499
detail: Limited-Edition Oakley Meta HSTN pre-orders opened as announced on 2025-06-20; limited edition shipped July 2025.

title: iFixit Oakley Meta HSTN teardown: 12 MP camera, AR1 Gen 1; no AF actuator or module supplier identified
detail: iFixit teardown of Oakley Meta HSTN: 12 MP camera, Qualcomm AR1 Gen 1, 852 mWh battery; "hinge is laced with delicate ribbon cables tied to the cameras"; no sensor part number, AF actuator or module supplier identified.

title: Oakley Meta HSTN standard models (from US$399) ship; 3K video, 8 h battery
detail: Standard Oakley Meta HSTN models began shipping 67 days after announcement.

title: Army awards Anduril $159M (with Meta, Qualcomm) and Rivet $195M for SBMC prototypes
detail: Army awarded Anduril $159M and Rivet $195M for Soldier Borne Mission Command (SBMC) prototypes; Anduril's system built 'in partnership with Meta, Qualcomm Technologies, OSI and Gentex'.

title: Connect 2025: Meta Ray-Ban Display US$799 with Neural Band, 12MP camera, on sale 2025-09-30
detail: Meta Ray-Ban Display: 600×600 monocular LCoS/waveguide display, 12MP ultra-wide camera, 3K video, 3× digital zoom, Neural Band sEMG, 69 g; on sale 2025-09-30 US-only, with "Canada, France, Italy and UK in early 2026".

title: Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2 US$379 available immediately; 12MP, 3K/30fps, 8 h
detail: Ray-Ban Meta (Gen 2) launched at Connect 2025 at US$379 with immediate availability (0-day lag).

title: Connect 2025: Oakley Meta Vanguard US$499, 12MP 122° centred camera, ships 2025-10-21
detail: Oakley Meta Vanguard announced at US$499 with a 12MP, 122° FOV centred camera and 9 h battery, shipping 2025-10-21.

title: Meta Ray-Ban Display ships in the US, 13 days after announcement
detail: Meta Ray-Ban Display went on sale in the US only.

title: iFixit/Lumafield CT teardown of Meta Ray-Ban Display: Lumus/Schott waveguide, OmniVision LCoS
detail: Teardown found a Lumus geometric waveguide made by Schott, OmniVision LCoS (OP03010), Snapdragon AR1, 32GB/2GB, 960 mWh battery; the camera module was not analysed.

title: Oakley Meta Vanguard ships in 17 countries, 34 days after announcement
detail: Oakley Meta Vanguard reached retail in 17 countries.

detail: [Verification: partially supported — TechCrunch 6 Dec 2025: Phoenix H2 2026 to H1 2027, Aul/Cairns 'get the details right', Bloomberg 30% cut. Saba memo and Quest 4 'large upgrade' restart confirmed via Road to VR; 'without subsidy' and 'target ship date' not

title: PCMag / The Independent reviews: Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2 camera is "simple fixed focus"
detail: [Verification: partially supported — PCMag review datePublished 2025-12-11 states 'The glasses shoot with a simple fixed focus and capture everything in front of you.' The Independent quote was not verifiable (no URL cited, not found by search).] PCMag: "The g

title: Leaker Luna posts Phoenix (Loma/Puffin) mock-up: premium lightweight VR HMD, H1 2027
detail: @Lunayian posted a mock-up of "Meta Proj. Phoenix (aka Loma, Puffin) … premium lightweight VR HMD, planned for H1 2027", with an external puck.

title: Meta pauses Ray-Ban Display expansion to UK/FR/IT/CA citing "limited inventory"
detail: Meta paused the Display's expansion to "the UK, France, Italy, and Canada, which was originally scheduled for early 2026" citing "unprecedented demand and limited inventory"; "product waitlists now extend well into 2026".

title: Bloomberg: Meta discussing doubling Ray-Ban glasses output to 20m+/yr by end-2026
detail: Bloomberg reported Meta was discussing doubling Ray-Ban glasses output after a demand surge, with annual capacity of 20 m+ by end-2026 discussed.

title: Meta FY2025: glasses sales "more than tripled"; Reality Labs loss US$19.19bn on US$2.21bn revenue
detail: Zuckerberg: "Sales of our glasses more than tripled"; Reality Labs Q4 revenue US$955m (-12% YoY), FY2025 revenue US$2,207m, FY operating loss US$19,193m; RL investment to go "mostly" to glasses/wearables.

title: Second leaker posts Phoenix compute-puck mock-ups; target H1 2027
detail: Noridoesvr posted compute-puck mock-ups (waist clip, cooling exhaust); Tom's Guide/Yahoo recapped Phoenix renders with an H1 2027 target.

title: Bosworth: "two devices on the roadmap" — Phoenix (H1 2027) and Quest 4 "Griffin" (≥H2 2027)
detail: CTO Andrew Bosworth (Davos, to Alex Heath): "I think it's officially leaked we've got two devices on the roadmap" — ultralight Phoenix (H1 2027) and gaming Quest 4 codenamed "Griffin" (no earlier than H2 2027).

title: EssilorLuxottica FY2025: "sold over 7 million AI glasses" in 2025 vs 2m in 2023+2024
detail: EssilorLuxottica Q4/FY2025 results: over 7m Meta AI glasses (Ray-Ban + Oakley) sold in 2025 vs 2m in 2023 and 2024 combined.

title: The Information: "Hypernova 2 will launch this year, not in 2027"; smartwatch revived
detail: Jyoti Mann: execs "concerned that launching too many devices in quick succession could confuse customers"; smartwatch revived for 2026. UploadVR notes Bloomberg/Kuo had said binocular Hypernova 2 in 2027, ultralight headset early 2027, true AR H2 2027. (No new

title: Quest firmware reveals Phoenix setup graphics: eye tracking, 0.9-in micro-OLED, <110 g, H1 2027
detail: UploadVR found Phoenix setup graphics in Quest firmware: glasses-style nose pads, eye tracking, auto-IPD, iris unlock, <110 g, one display candidate 0.9-inch micro-OLED, "Quest Air" among names considered, target H1 2027.

title: Seeya starts mass production of Phoenix OLEDoS panel (ONNA1); >1m shipped by late Aug; BOE failed Meta qualification
detail: THE ELEC via 腾讯/LEDinside: '视涯科技自今年5月已启动对应面板的规模化量产，截至目前累计出货量突破100万片'; 0.91", 2560x2560; Phoenix 'locked for launch in 1H next year'. Seeya: 'please refer to announcements'.

title: The Information memo: four 2026 glasses (Modelo, Luna, RBM2 Refresh, Mojito VIP); 10m H2 target
detail: Internal memo: "Modelo" June 2026, "Luna" autumn 2026 (camera-free), "RBM2 Refresh" fall 2026, "Mojito VIP" Dec 2026; "Artemis" and "SSG" (super-sensing) in testing; target 10m wearables in H2 2026; AI pendant; EssilorLuxottica agreement extended through 2030

title: Meta confirms Connect 2026 for Sept 23–24
detail: Meta confirmed Connect 2026 dates (teased ~May 2026).

title: "Meta Glasses" own-brand line launches from US$299, 26 styles, 12MP, 3K video
detail: Meta and EssilorLuxottica launched the Meta Glasses line (Adventurer, Fury, "by Kylie"; 26 styles; 12MP, 3K video, >8 h), available same day — matches the "Modelo" June slot reported by The Information.

title: Meta Q2 2026: Reality Labs revenue US$431m (+16%), loss US$4.62bn; EL glasses revenue ~doubled
detail: Reality Labs revenue US$431m (+16%), operating loss US$4.62bn; glasses growth outweighed lower Quest sales; EssilorLuxottica said Q2 revenue from Meta AI glasses almost doubled.

title: Meta Reality Labs software engineer on Meta VR Glasses: 'I led the autofocus work' — 'Autofocus: Yes' on the spec sheet 'took years of effort across the whole stack'
detail: Public LinkedIn post (late Sept / early Oct 2026, reposting Meta VR product VP Angela Chang's 'A New Era for VR'), seen via a forum screenshot of LinkedIn's Norwegian auto-translation. Paraphrase: has worked on Meta VR Glasses since the project began, presenti

title: Meta Connect 2026 / Meta VR glasses announced: no coverage links poLight, TLens or Q Tech
detail: Bloomberg, UploadVR, Road to VR, TechCrunch, Fortune and MediaPost (09-28) coverage from 2026-09-23 to 10-06 found no link between poLight/TLens/Q Tech and Meta glasses; a 21jingji 2026-09-24 pre-market piece returned 503.

title: First clear Phoenix visuals in HorizonOS firmware: sensors on temple sides/undersides, puck cable
detail: UploadVR found Phoenix visuals in the HorizonOS Prescription Lens app: slim frame with nose pads, "sensors visible on the sides and undersides of the temples", puck cable to left temple, Zenni-style Rx inserts via QR.

title: UDN: Phoenix renders in Meta Prescription Lens app show miniature stereo camera array; launch pushed to 1H27
detail: '正面勢必搭載微型立體相機陣列'; '實際量產與上市時間可能已推遲至2027年上半年'.

title: The Information: camera-free "Luna" could debut at Connect 2026
detail: Reported that camera-free "Luna" glasses could debut at Connect; they did, as Ray-Ban Meta Audio.

title: UploadVR: Meta to demo Phoenix at Connect with full-body Codec Avatars
detail: Phoenix to be demoed at Connect with full-body Codec Avatars ("Hologram" calling); positioned as a premium successor to Quest Pro.

title: AR圈 supplier list: Phoenix SoC Qualcomm, assembly and Pancake module Goertek, Micro-OLED Seeya
detail: '凤凰VR的SOC芯片由高通供应，整机制造与Pancake光机模组均由歌尔股份承担，MicroOLED屏幕来自视涯科技'. For AI glasses: assembly Essilor Luxottica's 东莞华宏 and Goertek, camera sensor Sony, camera module Sunny. No camera-module or actuator supplier named for Phoenix; claims unsourced.

title: Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 from US$449 available same day; 12MP, 3K, 9 h, AI button
detail: Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 launched at Connect 2026 with immediate availability; focus type not stated and no review found claiming autofocus.

title: Ray-Ban Meta Audio US$349 camera-free glasses announced, 43 g, ships 2026-10-13
detail: Camera-free Ray-Ban Meta Audio (the reported "Luna") opened for pre-order at US$349, shipping 2026-10-13.

title: Meta Adventurer US$249 glasses announced, ships 2026-10-23; "100+ styles" by year-end
detail: Meta Adventurer at US$249 announced for 2026-10-23 shipping; Meta targets "100+ styles" by year-end; Muse Charm teased.

title: Meta Ray-Ban Display on sale in Canada (CA$1,149) and UK (£749); FR/IT/DE pre-order €899
detail: International Display availability resumed ~371 days after US launch, following the January 2026 supply pause; France/Italy/Germany pre-orders ship 2026-10-13.
